extDesc.message: Cast this tab to a Chromecast / Google TV and control the TV. Works with the Fling app (Windows, Linux).

cmdCastTab.message: Cast this tab to the TV

offlineBody.message: This extension talks to the Fling app. Start Fling on this computer and it connects on its own.

openVideoPage.message: Open a web page in this browser, then try again.

needCatt.message: Fling needs catt — open the Fling panel.

pairHint.message: Pair once with the TV to unlock apps, the d-pad and typing.

scrollHint.message: or scroll here to move around the TV

optShareTabs.message: Let Fling see which tab is open

optShareTabsHint.message: Lets the panel's “Cast this tab” and the system-wide shortcut work with this browser. The address goes only to the Fling app on this computer (127.0.0.1), never to the internet. Tabs from private windows are never shared.

optPause.message: Pause the video here after casting

optPauseHint.message: So the sound doesn't play twice.

optPortHint.message: Change only if bridge_port in fling.json is different (47613 by default).

credit.message: Original Fling by Damion Rashford and Tatiana · unofficial port by orfixe

optNotifyHint.message: A Windows / desktop notification from the Fling app with the new title. Same switch as “Notify when the video changes” in the Fling panel.

cmdCastNow.message: Cast this tab from the current moment

seekHint.message: Click to jump to this point

optShortcutsFirefox.message: Open about:addons, click the gear icon and choose “Manage Extension Shortcuts”.

optShortcutsManual.message: Open your browser's Extensions page and look for “Keyboard shortcuts”.

optRecentHint.message: They appear under the Fling toolbar button, so you can cast them again. Stored only in this browser; nothing from private windows is saved.
